# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first portrait browser game titled `Rift Riders: Midnight Patrol`. Preserve the protected source loop: top-down joystick movement in a large world, friction and speed cap, camera follow, rotated rectangular ramp collisions that launch the rider, three airborne-only action buttons, combo payout on clean landing, obstacle bounce hazards, manual end/debrief, and restart.

Theme the game as an 80s small-town sci-fi horror adventure: a bike-riding teen scout carries a walkie beacon through streets, houses, lab silhouettes, red portal veins, and shadow spores. Use readable portrait UI with Evidence, Bike Pace, FLASH/RADIO/FRIEND buttons, neon cyan/magenta/amber role colors, synth-dread audio, and browser-native procedural canvas art. Do not add new combat, health, timers, inventories, or alternate scoring rules.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source identity and behavior
The preserved source is a mobile-first top-down traversal/trick game. A player avatar accelerates with a left virtual joystick across a large world, collides with rectangular gates/ramps to enter an airborne state, taps one of three action buttons while airborne, and receives score only when landing cleanly after a completed signal/trick. Obstacles bounce the player and cause a risky air state. The run can be ended manually, producing a final-score overlay and restart button.

## Protected mechanic truth
- Joystick movement, acceleration, friction, speed cap, camera follow, and world bounds.
- Ground/air state machine with gravity, vertical position, and landing logic.
- Rotated rectangular ramp/gate collision and hazard bump collision.
- Three action buttons gated to airborne state only.
- Combo-to-score payout on clean landing and combo drop on missed timing.
- Manual end/debrief and restart flow.

## Safe theming surfaces
HUD language, title, copy, audio, fonts, canvas drawing, background motifs, entity shapes, particles, modal wording, and color roles are safe to transform because they do not alter the protected loop.

## Remixed target
`Rift Riders: Midnight Patrol` reframes the loop as bike-riding teens investigating supernatural portals in a dark 80s small town. Ramps are rift seams, tricks are flashlight/radio/friendship signals, hazards are shadow spores/lab debris, and score is recovered evidence.
